description: Today's demand patterns from DECA's radar: groups of apps climbing the App Store and Google Play charts, with what people say and want about them and the public posts behind it. Every chart fact names its store category and country. Free. Updated daily.

heat.description: Only patterns people are talking about this much. Optional.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the pattern, its apps or what people say. Optional.

name: get_signals
title: Demand signals
